summary: This directory serves as the dedicated space for testing the initialization logic of the document base context. It ensures that the fundamental state or configuration required for document operations is correctly set up before being used by other components.
responsibilities: Verify the correct initialization of the document base context
Ensure environmental or state prerequisites for document handling are satisfied
relationships: Unit tests validate that the document base context is initialized according to defined requirements.
The initialization logic establishes the state necessary for the document base context to function.
designDecisions: Colocation of test suites with their corresponding core logic components
Isolation of initialization concerns for unit-level verification
